FLYER by BandLab

The Flyer Wall

Infinite shared music wall mapped to real cities. Post flyers, swipe between districts, play embedded Spotify tracks, open arcade games. 6 launch cities, 60+ flyer types, tube map navigation.

Arcade · HTML5 Game

Beat Invaders

Music-themed Space Invaders with powerups, boss battles, Galaga-style swarming, and combo system. Playable from inside FLYER arcade-machine flyers. Web Audio sound effects.

Play game
SongSugar · Classic

Drop Cast — Classic

Tetris-style music block game. Coloured music blocks fall into a grid — match colours to clear rows and build combos. PixiJS rendering with Tone.js audio engine. The original StreamToys game.

Play game
SongSugar · Collapse

Drop Cast — Collapse

Tap-to-collapse puzzle variant. Tap clusters of matching colours to clear them — remaining blocks fall and shift. Chain reactions build score multipliers. Advanced controller with multiple game modes.

Play game
Soundgarden · Legacy Concept

Biome Creature Concepts

The original Soundgarden direction — bioluminescent creatures that grow from music, evolving across six musical biomes (Drift, Pulse, Fracture, Swing, Hush, Grid). Includes animated creature showcase, evolution stages, and design principles. Superseded by the FLYER wall direction but preserved as visual reference.
